notes: lobe_of is functional, a subproperty of part_of, with the chain lobe_of o part_of in part_of (catalogue). The brain and the lung share no part (the record's revision fact) is a firm rule. The department table in q2's prompt has no catalogued relation, so neurology and pulmonology are surfaces of the nervous and respiratory systems (a one-to-one lookup in the prompt); the tumour is the occipital lobe itself.

bridge_refs.lung_resp: The lung is part of the respiratory system.
bridge_refs.lung_thoracic: The lung is in the thoracic cavity.
bridge_refs.v1_occ: The primary visual cortex is part of the occipital lobe.

revision_refs.separate: The brain and the lung are separate organs with no part in common.
